description: AI-powered artwork analysis. Two tiers: 'standard' (1 GCX) = SEO-optimized title, description, keywords, alt_text via Nova-Lite. 'premium' (2 GCX, default) = full 8-section Golden Codex museum-grade analysis via Nova/Gemini 2.5 Pro. Optionally customize metadata fields and add a Soul Whisper personal message. ($0.20 / 2 GCX)

content_type.description: Content type hint: 'artwork' or 'photo' — affects analysis style

context.description: Creator's brief — technical/artistic context for AI analysis (e.g. 'SD 3.5 Large, impressionist style')

soul_whisper.description: Optional personal message embedded in metadata — visible to anyone who reads the image's provenance (premium tier only)

message.description: Personal message, dedication, or story behind the artwork (max 1000 chars)

tier.description: Metadata tier: 'standard' (1 GCX — SEO title/description/keywords/alt_text) or 'premium' (2 GCX — full Golden Codex 8-section analysis)

title.description: Artwork title (leave blank for AI to suggest one)

name: enrich_metadata
